skills.detail:
1st Hit:
A long-range attack with a chance to set enemies Aflame.

2nd Hit:
A long-range attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to set enemies Aflame. Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat. Deals an additional amount of fixed damage to enemies while in Flame Emperor state. This will deal a fixed amount of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Become temporarily invincible after use. Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: Fire Fist: Rook Check

skills.detail:
Skill 2 changes to Flame Emperor's Counterattack while capturing Treasure. After using Flame Emperor's Counterattack, you will stop capturing Treasure and Skill 2 will transform back into Flame Emperor's Strike.

Puts the character in Flame Emperor state. While in Flame Emperor state, ATK is increased for Normal Attacks and the character can only be targeted by Normal Attacks, cannot be Staggered, and gains Status Effect Nullification. Deals a close-range attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to set enemies Aflame while the skill button is held down. Reduces damage taken and reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released. Also, has a chance to set enemies Aflame. You are able to move while holding down the skill button.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
